name: Kazama Kouta
source:
Kouta is [url=/c77625]Aki's[/url] childhood friend for whom he has always had particularly strong feelings, without really understanding what they were. Passionate about photography, he spends his free time photographing all the landscapes he finds pretty, a passion he was passed on to him by his parents. One day, as he was uploading his pictures to his club room computer, his mother Yuri contacted him to tell him that there had been a bathtub accident at home and that it was going to be renovated.

"Starting from tomorrow, you'll be staying at Aki's place" she said. This is difficult for a teenager who doesn't understand how he feels about the person he cares about the most. Thus began his adventure with his best pal Aki...
